script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

INT. FRANCESCA'S KITCHEN - DAY

FRANCESCA, a vibrant 50-something Italian woman, kneads dough on a wooden table. Sweat glistens on her brow. Her apron is covered in flour. LORENZO, her grandson, enters, his eyes following a trail of flour on the floor.

LORENZO
(Curious)
Grandma, what are you making?

FRANCESCA
(Gently)
I'm making pasta for dinner, my dear.

LORENZO
(Excited)
Can I help?

FRANCESCA
(Smiling)
Of course, Lorenzo. That's the spirit.

INT. FRANCESCA'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Francesca and Lorenzo sit at the dining table, covered in pasta, sauce, and laughter.

FRANCESCA
(Wistfully)
You know, my dear, I've always loved making pasta. It reminds me of home.

LORENZO
(Intrigued)
What do you mean?

FRANCESCA
(Pensive)
I mean... I was never really Italian growing up. My parents were immigrants, and we struggled to fit in. But when I make pasta, I feel connected to my heritage.

LORENZO
(Thoughtful)
But, Grandma, you're Italian! I mean, you're an amazing cook, and you've passed down so many traditions to us.

FRANCESCA
(Sighs)
But my heart has always wondered, what would life have been like if I had grown up there?

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Francesca and Lorenzo sit at a large wooden table, surrounded by books about Italy.

LORENZO
(Excited)
Look at this, Grandma! We can even check out travel books to see what Italy looks like today!

FRANCESCA
(Nods)
Yes, we can do that, my dear. And maybe, just maybe, we'll find a piece of the puzzle that's been missing for me.

INT. ITALIAN VILLAGE - DAY

Francesca and Lorenzo explore the quaint Italian village, taking in the sights, sounds, and smells. They visit local markets, try new foods, and make new friends.

INT. ITALIAN KITCHEN - NIGHT

Francesca and Lorenzo sit at a rustic kitchen table, surrounded by locals. They share stories, laughter, and pasta.

FRANCESCA
(Smiling)
I feel like I've found a piece of myself here, Lorenzo. A part of my identity that I thought was lost forever.

LORENZO
(Happily)
But Grandma, you've always been Italian. It's in your heart, in your cooking, in your love for your family.

FRANCESCA
(Tearfully)
Thank you, Lorenzo. I needed this journey to remind me of that.

INT. FRANCESCA'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

Francesca and Lorenzo sit at the table, covered in pasta and sauce. They share stories and laughter.

FRANCESCA
(Contentedly)
You know, my dear, I think I've finally found my place in the world. And it's right here, with you.

LORENZO
(Smiling)
And that, Grandma, is all that matters.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
